finding.text: The branch re-creates the old tree it set out to remove: it adds `ai/2026/files.jsonl`, `ai/2026/09/files.jsonl` and `ai/2026/09/19/files.jsonl` (the `PageFiles.js` watcher's listings, written while folders moved; the task log names this caveat). That is the "stale fragment" the owner's ask 3 rules out — diff.patch, three `new file` entries outside `ai/sessions/`. Remove them (`git rm`) before the merge, and run the main-tree sweep with the watcher held or stopped.

`Servex/cards/readme.md` was only half updated: the day index line shows the new `ai/sessions/…/cards/` path, but the two card lines below it still show `ai/2026/09/24/fix-the-sidebar/…` as folders. One code block now holds both trees (content: names used the same way every time).

Ask 2's real apply in the main tree, `check_page` at 1200, smoke and `merge.mjs`, and all of ask 4, have not happened yet: `git log` shows no merge and task.jsonl stops at the `shots` line. This is expected before the gate, so it is a note, but the landing has to do them.
